title: Books, Stories, and Creative Projects from Ketty’s World
subtitle: SANNATA Library
about_text: The SANNATA Library brings together books created within Ketty’s world and the people who shape it. Here you will find travel stories, personal journals, creative dialogues, artistic projects, and educational materials. Each book is its own universe, yet all of them share a common purpose: to inspire, to encourage learning, and to open new perspectives.
list_items: books based on dialogues between artists and creators
educational materials on programming and technology
future children’s books inspired by Mr. Shi’s lessons
books featuring coloring pages and creative prompts for all ages
audience_text: The SANNATA Library is created for readers of all ages — from 7 to 100. These books are chosen by parents, educators, creative professionals, and everyone who appreciates stories with depth and character. At the same time, each book remains accessible and engaging for younger readers: they include coloring pages, creative prompts, visual elements, and a gentle style that makes the experience enjoyable for any age. Our books bring generations together. Adults read them for themselves and then share them with children. Children explore the illustrations, color the pages, and ask questions. This is how shared reading begins — calm, warm, and meaningful.
ketty_text: Ketty is not just a character — she is a point of connection. Through her perspective, we explore travel, creativity, family, learning, and growing up. Her stories become books, and these books become part of a larger project that evolves alongside her.
shi_text: Some books feature Mr. Shi — a kind digital mentor created to help Ketty learn, explore, and understand the world. His lessons will become the foundation of a future children’s book where technology and imagination meet in a safe and inspiring way.
